objective: Evaluate one matched liquid-ETF family spanning deterministic rules, fold-local trained models, frozen LLM-derived formula factors, combined models, exact missing-modality fallback, and a shuffled placebo; historical evidence is transfer evidence and formal advancement requires a new forward epoch.

sources.credibility: peer-reviewed Review of Financial Studies article
sources.core_claim: Nonlinear asset-pricing models can extract interactions among momentum, liquidity and volatility, while shallow models remain competitive in low-signal panels.
sources.project_applicability: Retain deterministic and shallow-tree comparisons with fold-local fitting.
sources.reflection: The paper uses a broader PIT universe and longer history than this fixed ETF panel.

sources.core_claim: Momentum losses cluster in stressed reversal regimes, motivating a separate state/risk role rather than unconditional model replacement.
sources.project_applicability: Evaluate a separately calibrated path-survival gate with exact deterministic fallback.
sources.reflection: Long-short crash evidence may overstate risk for a long-only ETF portfolio.

sources.credibility: public research paper and implementation project
sources.core_claim: R&D-Agent(Q) links hypothesis generation, factor implementation and empirical feedback in an iterative quant workflow.
sources.project_applicability: Persist source, formula, candidate, model, trial and decision bindings.
sources.reflection: Agent breadth raises multiple-testing risk without a frozen candidate budget.

sources.core_claim: AlphaBench emphasizes executable alpha generation, empirical evaluation, diversity and OOS generalization rather than trusting LLM self-evaluation.
sources.project_applicability: Subject LLM-derived formulas to matched ablations, missing-modality fallback and a shuffled placebo.
sources.reflection: Benchmark performance is not ETF alpha evidence.

sources.core_claim: A recent working paper combines text-proposed regime candidates with statistical validation rather than accepting LLM regime labels directly.
sources.project_applicability: Validate every LLM-proposed factor with market data and keep live LLM routing disabled.
sources.reflection: The Treasury study does not establish ETF momentum lift.

sources.core_claim: SEC submissions and filing documents expose accession identifiers and filing acceptance metadata suitable for PIT document packets.
sources.project_applicability: Exclude live filing/news factors from R5 because immutable PIT packets are not part of this round.
sources.reflection: R5 uses no filing text and makes no text-alpha claim.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca documents IEX as a single U.S. exchange representing about 2.5% of market volume and SIP as consolidated data covering all U.S. exchanges.
sources.project_applicability: Freeze SIP for every candidate and reject feed fallback.
sources.reflection: Feed breadth does not prove immutable or auction-accurate history.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca documents that opg with a market or limit order creates MOO or LOO interest eligible only for the opening auction.
sources.project_applicability: Use one protected OPG policy and explicit skip outcomes.
sources.reflection: Order eligibility does not establish fill quality or simulator fidelity.

sources.core_claim: Alpaca states that paper trading is a simulation and does not account for market impact, information leakage, latency slippage, non-marketable limit-order queue position, price improvement, regulatory fees, or dividends.
sources.project_applicability: Use Paper for controls and matched simulated-fill TCA only.
sources.reflection: A paper pass is not live alpha or capacity evidence.

sources.credibility: new arXiv methodology paper discovered by the preregistered scout
sources.core_claim: FinBench specifies strictly time-gated financial forecasts and uses Brier skill against hard baselines to evaluate probabilistic calibration.
sources.project_applicability: Require M02 to beat a base-rate Brier score within chronological folds.
sources.reflection: Its one-day, three-ticker pilot is too small to support a strategy-performance claim.

sources.credibility: arXiv official abstract page reviewed against the current source card
sources.core_claim: The paper evaluates an LLM factor-ranking pipeline using only decision-time information and finds that a matched kNN macro-analog baseline recovers a comparable median rank IC.
sources.project_applicability: Keep formula inputs PIT-safe and require matched quant-only and placebo comparisons before any LLM contribution claim.
sources.reflection: The study covers 36 months and seven style factors; its bootstrap confidence interval includes zero and it does not validate the R5 ETF formulas.

candidate_matrix_revisions: Use a fixed 14-ETF universe to avoid the prior current-stock-universe survivorship blocker.
Freeze exactly eight roles before evaluation: D01, D02, M01, M02, L01, C01, F01 and P01.
Transfer four R2 LLM-derived formulas unchanged; no historical formula search and no live LLM inference.
Require exact F01-to-M01 target identity and require C01 lift to exceed the seeded P01 placebo.
Treat history through 2026-07-17 as transfer evidence and require a new 2026-07-30 forward epoch before canary eligibility.
Use the new FinBench scout evidence only to confirm the already-frozen M02 Brier/base-rate gate; do not add a candidate or threshold.
Use the leakage-aware LLM ranking paper only to reinforce PIT and matched-baseline controls; do not add a formula, candidate or threshold.
